nodes.name: ArtistService.cs
nodes.summary: Data access service for artist overview pages, orchestrating Pathfinder GraphQL for top tracks, discography, concerts, music videos, merch, playlists, and related artists with local library fallback.

nodes.name: ArtistService
nodes.summary: Data service orchestrating artist overview pages including top tracks, discography, concerts, music videos, merch, playlists, and related artists.

nodes.name: ArtistService
nodes.summary: ArtistService method.

nodes.name: GetOverviewAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches the full artist overview from Pathfinder including header, top tracks, discography, concerts, music videos, merch, playlists, and related artists.

nodes.name: PrewarmMusicVideoCatalog
nodes.summary: Seeds the music video title-to-URI mapping dictionary from a fresh discography response.

nodes.name: MapConcertsAsync
nodes.summary: Converts raw Pathfinder concert data to ConcertDto enriched with venue and geo-location info.

nodes.name: GetDiscographyAllAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches a paginated slice of all discography releases for an artist URI.

nodes.name: GetDiscographyPageAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches a typed discography page (albums/singles/compilations) with offset and limit.

nodes.name: MapTier
nodes.summary: Maps a visual identity palette to the album tier classification for header styling.

nodes.name: MapPalette
nodes.summary: Converts a Pathfinder visual identity object to a serializable color palette record.

nodes.name: MapTopTracks
nodes.summary: Converts Pathfinder top-track objects to ArtistTopTrackDto with playcount and artist refs.

nodes.name: MapMusicVideoMappings
nodes.summary: Extracts a title-to-video-URI dictionary from the artist discography for video badge display.

nodes.name: AddMappings
nodes.summary: Merges new title-to-video-URI pairs into the existing mapping dictionary.

nodes.name: GetExtendedTopTracksAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches enriched track details for top tracks that need extended metadata.

nodes.name: GetTrackImagesAsync
nodes.summary: Resolves artwork URLs for top tracks from local cache or extended metadata.

nodes.name: MapReleaseGroup
nodes.summary: Maps a raw release-group record from Pathfinder to an ArtistReleaseDto.

nodes.name: MapPopularReleases
nodes.summary: Selects and maps the popular release section entries for the artist overview.

nodes.name: MapMusicVideos
nodes.summary: Converts music video entries to ArtistMusicVideoDto with matched URI lookups.

nodes.name: MapPlaylists
nodes.summary: MapPlaylists method.

nodes.name: AppendPlaylists
nodes.summary: Adds a paginated block of playlists to the running artist overview playlists list.

nodes.name: MapMerch
nodes.summary: Converts raw merch items to ArtistMerchDto for the merch shelf section.

nodes.name: MapRelatedArtists
nodes.summary: Maps related artist references from Pathfinder to RelatedArtistDto.

nodes.name: MapPinnedItem
nodes.summary: Converts a pinned item (album/playlist) from the artist profile to the pinned item DTO.

nodes.name: SynthesizeArtistOverviewResult
nodes.summary: Combines all fetched sections into the final ArtistOverviewResult DTO returned to the view model.

nodes.name: MapLocalTrackToArtistTopTrack
nodes.summary: Converts a local library track to ArtistTopTrackDto for artists with local files.

nodes.name: MapLocalAlbumSummaryToRelease
nodes.summary: Converts a local library album summary to ArtistReleaseDto for the discography list.

nodes.name: AuthStateService.cs
nodes.summary: Authentication state manager handling session restore, OAuth authorization-code and device-code login flows, logout, and user-profile population, broadcasting auth status via CommunityToolkit messenger.

nodes.name: AuthStateService
nodes.summary: Manages Spotify authentication state with session restore, OAuth flows, user profile population, and status broadcasting.

nodes.name: AuthStateService
nodes.summary: AuthStateService method.

nodes.name: TryRestoreSessionAsync
nodes.summary: Attempts to restore a previous session from cached credentials and populate user data.

nodes.name: LoginWithAuthorizationCodeAsync
nodes.summary: Runs the OAuth authorization-code flow, opening a browser and waiting for the redirect callback.

nodes.name: LoginWithDeviceCodeAsync
nodes.summary: Executes the OAuth device-code flow, displaying the code and polling for authorization.

nodes.name: LogoutAsync
nodes.summary: Clears cached credentials, resets session state, and broadcasts logout completion.

nodes.name: PopulateUserFromSession
nodes.summary: Fetches and stores user profile, account type, and country code after a successful session connect.

nodes.name: ConnectCommandExecutor.cs
nodes.summary: Central command executor for Spotify Connect operations, routing play/pause/seek/skip/shuffle/repeat/queue/transfer/audio-video-switch commands to the local audio engine or remote Connect devices.

nodes.name: ConnectCommandExecutor
nodes.summary: Routes all Spotify Connect playback commands to the local audio engine or remote devices, covering play/pause/seek/skip/shuffle/repeat/queue/transfer.

nodes.name: SetEqualizerAsync
nodes.summary: Applies a new equalizer band-gain configuration to the local audio pipeline.

nodes.name: ToPlaybackResult
nodes.summary: Converts an internal command result enum to the public PlaybackResult DTO.

nodes.name: ShouldBlockLocalSpotifyPlayback
nodes.summary: Determines whether local Spotify audio playback should be suppressed given current device and cluster state.

nodes.name: TryFindCurrentSpotifyAudioUri
nodes.summary: Resolves the currently active Spotify audio URI from local cluster or Connect state.

nodes.name: TryFindSpotifyAudioUri
nodes.summary: Searches queue and context buckets for a Spotify audio URI matching a given item.

nodes.name: TryFindSpotifyAudioUri
nodes.summary: Searches queue and context buckets for a Spotify audio URI matching a given item.

nodes.name: SendAsync
nodes.summary: Core dispatch method routing a playback command to the local engine or a remote Connect device with ACK waiting.

nodes.name: GetAckTimeout
nodes.summary: Returns the ACK timeout for a command type based on network latency expectations.

nodes.name: ShouldWaitForAck
nodes.summary: Returns whether the executor should await a Connect ACK for the given command type.

nodes.name: SwitchToContextAfterCurrentAsync
nodes.summary: Queues a context switch to occur after the currently playing track completes.

nodes.name: PlayContextAsync
nodes.summary: Initiates playback of a URI context (album/playlist/artist) at an optional offset via Connect.

nodes.name: PlayTracksAsync
nodes.summary: Starts playback of an explicit list of track URIs, building a synthetic context and queue.

nodes.name: PlayOriginFeatureFor
nodes.summary: Returns the play-origin feature string for a given playback context URI type.

nodes.name: PlayOriginFeatureForUri
nodes.summary: Returns the play-origin feature string for a specific item URI within a context.

nodes.name: SetRepeatAsync
nodes.summary: Sets the repeat mode (off/context/track) on the local engine or remote device.

nodes.name: SetPlaybackSpeedAsync
nodes.summary: Adjusts the playback speed for the current track (podcast/audiobook contexts).

nodes.name: ReorderQueueAsync
nodes.summary: Reorders items in the user queue by moving a range to a new position.

nodes.name: SkipToQueueItemAsync
nodes.summary: Skips playback to a specific item in the queue by its queue-position index.

nodes.name: SendQueueMutationAsync
nodes.summary: Executes a queue mutation with ACK waiting and cluster sync.

nodes.name: BuildSetQueueBody
nodes.summary: Constructs the SetQueue protobuf payload from current queue state with a new ordering.

nodes.name: RouteToLocalEngineAsync
nodes.summary: Handles all commands directed at the local audio engine, translating Connect command types to AudioEngine API calls.

nodes.name: BuildPlayCommand
nodes.summary: Constructs the Connect Play command protobuf for a context or track list playback request.

nodes.name: TransferPlaybackAsync
nodes.summary: Transfers active playback to a different Connect device, optionally preserving current position.

nodes.name: SwitchAudioOutputAsync
nodes.summary: Changes the local audio output device and reconnects the audio pipeline.

nodes.name: SwitchToVideoAsync
nodes.summary: Switches the current track from audio to the music video rendition if available.

nodes.name: SwitchToAudioAsync
nodes.summary: Switches back from a music video rendition to the standard audio track.

nodes.name: ConnectivityService.cs
nodes.summary: Service that monitors Spotify session connection state changes and broadcasts connectivity status messages to the UI via CommunityToolkit messenger.

nodes.name: ConnectivityService
nodes.summary: Monitors session connection state and broadcasts connectivity change messages.

nodes.name: OnConnectionStateChanged
nodes.summary: Handles session connection state changes and broadcasts ConnectionStatusChangedMessage.

nodes.name: FriendsFeedService.cs
nodes.summary: Real-time friends activity feed service that subscribes to Dealer presence push messages, fetches per-user friend presence via SpClient, and maintains an observable list of FriendFeedRowViewModels with watchdog reseeding and per-row tick refresh.

nodes.name: FriendsFeedService
nodes.summary: Subscribes to Dealer presence pushes to maintain a live observable list of friends activity rows with watchdog reseeding and per-row tick refresh.

nodes.name: FriendsFeedService
nodes.summary: Constructor wiring auth status reception, initializing the observable collection, and starting Dealer subscription.

nodes.name: Receive
nodes.summary: Handles CommunityToolkit messenger messages to subscribe or tear down on auth state changes.

nodes.name: TearDown
nodes.summary: Cancels all in-flight requests, disposes Dealer subscriptions, and clears the friends list on logout.

nodes.name: TrySubscribeToDealer
nodes.summary: Subscribes to Dealer presence push messages and connection-ID changes to drive friend feed updates.

nodes.name: OnConnectionIdChanged
nodes.summary: Reacts to Dealer connection ID changes by cancelling pending work and reseeding the friend feed.

nodes.name: CancelAllUserFetches
nodes.summary: Cancels and disposes all per-user presence-fetch CancellationTokenSources.

nodes.name: OnDealerPush
nodes.summary: Handles incoming presence push messages by dispatching async per-user upsert operations.

nodes.name: FetchAndUpsertUserAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches friend presence data from SpClient for a single user and upserts or removes their row.

nodes.name: UpsertRow
nodes.summary: Inserts or replaces a FriendFeedRowViewModel at the correct sorted position in the observable list.

nodes.name: RemoveRowForUser
nodes.summary: Removes the row for a given user URI from the observable list.

nodes.name: SetActive
nodes.summary: Activates or deactivates the feed, starting or stopping the watchdog and row-tick timers.

nodes.name: RefreshAsync
nodes.summary: Forces a manual reseed of the friend feed from the SpClient API.

nodes.name: OnSafetyTick
nodes.summary: Watchdog timer callback that reseeds the feed if no Dealer push has been received within the interval.

nodes.name: SeedAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches the full friend feed snapshot from SpClient and applies it to the observable list.

nodes.name: ApplySnapshot
nodes.summary: Replaces the observable list contents with a new sorted snapshot from a SpClient feed response.

nodes.name: Dispose
nodes.summary: Disposes all timers, cancels in-flight work, and releases Dealer subscriptions.

nodes.name: OnRowTick
nodes.summary: Per-row timer callback that refreshes relative timestamps on all visible feed rows.
